scope: Authentication Token Canonicalization & Test Reliability Reconciliation

trigger.finding: The test mutated the final Base64URL signature character; alternate non-canonical encodings can decode to identical signature bytes because unused padding bits may differ.

correction.production_hardening: Reject non-canonical Base64URL signature encodings before constant-time HMAC comparison
correction.test_hardening: Mutate a deterministic signature byte and add an explicit equivalent-byte/non-canonical encoding rejection test

rule: Do not hide post-closure failures. Reconcile, harden, re-certify, and archive a superseding exact-commit baseline.
